build_matched.why: The tablet was meant to be running build 03358855 (v0.2.0.1-858-g03358855) when this session was recorded, but the session is labelled 894089c, a September build that no longer exists. Either a bug carried the old label forward from the farm's save, or the tablet was still running an old install; which one is still being found out. On 2026-10-09 this short session replays exactly to its autosave both on 03358855 and on 0903cfee, which stands in for 894089c (see the 2026-09-25 sessions), so either way it is tied to a build on GitHub. It is tied to 03358855 here.
